# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We actively support and patch the following versions of CineSwipe:

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| < 1.0.x | Yes       |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within this repository, please do **NOT** open a public issue. Instead, please report it privately:

1. **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting:** Go to the "Security" tab of this repository, select "Advisories", and click "Report a vulnerability" (if enabled).
2. **Email:** Reach out privately to the project maintainer.

We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and provide a detailed timeline for a security patch within 7 days.
